jordan_sales: Passing Peregrine Health to CS — quick context: 5-week POC, 3 product teams, currently on hosted API. They've asked for a Dedicated estimate + VPC and Okta SSO. Decision window ~8 weeks (renewal/commit). Trial NPS dropped to ~6 due to hallucinations on legal-doc prompts; they flagged some PII leakage concerns. No infra outages. SSO is failing for group mapping during provisioning. I'll be hands-off after today; assigning taylor as lead for onboarding and escalation.
taylor_csm: Thanks Jordan — taking ownership. Can you attach the latest SOW and the billing contact? Also need the Okta admin contact so we can reproduce SSO errors.
jordan_sales: Attaching the SOW to the workspace (link): https://drive.company/peregrine/sow-v3.pdf. Billing contact: maria.perez@peregrine.com. Okta admin: ryan.okta@peregrine.com. Note: they asked for a dedicated pool of 4 GPUs initially; unsure on expected QPS.
taylor_csm: Got it. Initial plan: 1) repro SSO (owner: alex_support) 2) onboarding checklist + access (owner: taylor_csm) 3) model quality triage (owner: maya_eng) 4) Dedicated sizing + pricing (owner: sam_ops). Target: basic prod-ready flow in 3 weeks.
alex_support: I'll repro the Okta mapping issue — need the IdP metadata and a failing SAML assertion sample. jordan, can you forward the failure logs Ryan sent or grant me read on their Okta app?
jordan_sales: Done, alex — shared their Okta logs and added you to the folder. Ryan also pasted an error snippet: `Invalid group mapping: role not found`
taylor_csm: For tracking, creating a single thread for tasks; please add short updates there. Also, Peregrine indicated they'd like a sandbox private deployment for legal review before full Dedicated. We should sequence: sandbox private -> eval -> Dedicated.
maya_eng: I'll start QA on the hallucination reports. Can you paste a minimal repro prompt + example output? If it's model behavior we can try constrained decoding or a safety reranker; if it's dataset-related we can suggest prompt engineering and a small eval suite.
taylor_csm: Example prompt from Peregrine: "Summarize clause 4.2 and list parties." They said model invents party names occasionally. Example output attached in the drive.
maya_eng: Thanks — I'll run a quick reproduce on the same model+config. If we see consistent fabrication we can propose a small fine-tune or a retrieval-augmented approach.
sam_ops: For Dedicated: 4x A100 equivalent is a reasonable starting point given their workload estimate. Rough monthly commit ballpark: $18k/mo (we'll refine after we get token QPS). I'll create a draft quote and attach.
support_bot: Ticket created: CS-4821 — "peregrine-okta-group-mapping" (assigned to alex_support). Link: https://tickets.company/CS-4821
taylor_csm: Action items (owners & ETA):
- Alex: reproduce SSO + provide workaround (ETA 48h)
- Maya: run model quality triage and share mitigation options (ETA 72h)
- Sam: draft Dedicated estimate + options (ETA 72h)
- Taylor: schedule kickoff, enable access, capture eval prompts (ETA 24h)
- Jordan: intro email to Ryan + Maria confirming POC timeline and next steps (ETA today)
jordan_sales: Sent intro email to Ryan/Maria and cc'd taylor + alex.
 alex_support: Reproducing SSO now; quick ask — what's the expected group-to-role mapping? Sample config they attempted:
```
role_mappings:
  - okta_group: "Legal-Review"
    redwood_role: "reviewer"
```
I suspect case-sensitivity in the mapping.
taylor_csm: Noted. I'll ask Peregrine to check exact group names; I'll also add a fallback mapping for case-insensitive match.
maya_eng: Quick update: reproduced hallucination once locally with same prompt. Short-term mitigation: constrain generation length and add a verification pass against retrieved doc text. I'll put two recommended config patches in the doc.
sam_ops: Quote draft uploaded: https://internal.company/quotes/peregrine-dedicated-v1.pdf — includes sandbox private option and 4-GPU baseline + burst.
taylor_csm: Great. I'll consolidate these into a CS playbook for Peregrine and create a Slack channel #cs-peregrine for ongoing comms. Any blockers I should flag now?
alex_support: None from infra after repro; will push temporary mapping fix and update ticket.
maya_eng: I'll need access to their sample docs for retrieval experiments — added a request on the shared drive.
jordan_sales: Thanks everyone. Please add short daily updates in this thread for the first week. Will check back next Wed. :thumbsup:
